post_operation: none (allocation flag itself is the bug)
path_conditions: Caller (tipc_bcast_init) runs at module/net-namespace init time; no spinlock held, no IRQ context, no atomic section. GFP_ATOMIC is unnecessary and wasteful of the atomic reserve.
notes: delay-gfp pattern: kzalloc/kmalloc/etc called with GFP_ATOMIC from a never-atomic context (init / probe / never-callable-under-spinlock). Fix replaces flag with GFP_KERNEL. The critical signal is the *allocation flag* at the call site combined with the enclosing function being a non-atomic context (typically a *_init / probe / process-context entry point).
